description: Send again the transfers of a partial payout run that are due for a retry (after a network error, a timeout or a Stripe outage), each with the same idempotency key as before, so Stripe never pays one twice. The amounts were approved already, so no new approval is needed. A transfer that failed for good is not retried: request a new run once the cause is fixed. 409 when nothing is due yet (the error's details say when the next retry is), 503 while Stripe is not ready. Answers 404 while payout runs are not switched on for your workspace (list_payout_runs says so in execution.enabled). Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

run_id.description: The payout run: id on a list_payout_runs or request_payout_run result.
